# Bridge Performance – Richard Ritmeijer

> Bridge Performance is the bridge coaching practice of Richard Ritmeijer, world bridge champion (World Mixed Teams 2016, Wrocław) and winner of the 2017 Champions Cup. He has taught bridge since 2000 and coaches players, partnerships and teams from club level to international level, online for players anywhere in the world.

Based in Zwolle, the Netherlands. Languages: English and Dutch. Coaching takes place online, so time zones in Europe, the Americas, Asia, Africa and Oceania can all be accommodated.

## Services
- [Coaching & contact](https://www.bridgeperformance.coach/coaching/): private online bridge coaching and hiring Richard as a professional partner at tournaments, for players of any level.
- [About Richard Ritmeijer](https://www.bridgeperformance.coach/about/): background, titles and coaching approach.

## Related
- [Bridge Performance (Dutch)](https://www.bridgeperformance.nl): the Dutch site, including in-person coaching in the Netherlands.
- [Bridge Academie](https://bridgeacademie.nl): Dutch-language bridge lessons, courses and club clinics by the same teacher.
